# synology_sftp (Resource)

SFTP file-sharing configuration. SSH terminal access remains a separate setting.

## Adopt existing settings

1. Add the import block below with your resource address and the ID of the existing DSM object.
2. Set your arguments to the values DSM currently reports. The sample configuration shows the shape and uses example values.
3. Run `terraform plan`. For one import, apply only when it reports `1 to import, 0 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy`.

```terraform
import {
  to = synology_sftp.main
  id = "sftp"
}
```

## Example configuration

```terraform
resource "synology_sftp" "main" {
  enabled = false
  port    = 22
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable SFTP.
- `port` (Number) SFTP listening port.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identity and import identifier: sftp. Destroy only releases Terraform management; it never resets DSM settings.
